value.rationale: The field-of-definition degree for an Aronhold heptad is a natural arithmetic invariant of the 288-sheeted marking cover of genus-three quartic moduli. The complete eight-value necessary spectrum and uniform degree-twelve cutoff are a motivated finite classification; class12C proves a nontrivial distinction between a rational bitangent, degree-six Cayley octad, and degree-twelve Aronhold marking.
